speaker: Doctor
text: Good morning, I see you're experiencing double vision, trouble climbing stairs, and weakness in your arms. To better understand the pattern of your symptoms, could you tell me if these issues started suddenly or developed gradually over time?

speaker: Patient
text: The double vision usually happens when I look up or down, and the weakness in my arms and legs gets worse after activity but improves if I rest. I have not noticed balance problems or numbness.

speaker: Doctor
text: That pattern of worsening with activity and improving with rest is very concerning for a neuromuscular junction disorder, such as Myasthenia Gravis; has this weakness been present for months or years? REQUEST TEST: Acetylcholine_receptor_antibodies, Repetitive_nerve_stimulation. DIAGNOSIS READY: Myasthenia Gravis
